Q1.text: O1 says g3-g5 hold, but rl_val_eval lists g4 (longitudinal bias rows) under not_computed: nothing on RL-val can show g4 holds. vacuous = treat g4 as holding; blocking = O1 cannot be certified.

Q2.what: which epo_kl is 'the mean at the breach'
Q2.text: epo_kl is logged every 25 updates as a window mean. second/first_breach_window = mean of the rows in (previous check, that check]; both = (check before the first breach, second breach]; row_at_* = the single row at that update.

Q3.what: an NC fall inside a g5 breach
Q3.text: g5 = NC and TTC; O5 lists 'an NC / DAC bound', which section 5 never defines. g5 = an NC-involved breach is still O3/O4; O5 = it is the O5 NC bound.

Q4.what: O2's 'PDMS B - A lower bound <= 0' (which check)
Q4.text: O1 needs LB > 0 at u500 AND u1000; O2 names no check. both = LB <= 0 at u500 and u1000; final = at u1000; either = at u500 or u1000.

Q5.text: O2's condition names g5 only. as_written = g3 is not required; g3_also = O2 also needs g3 to hold at every check.

Q6.what: the +0.25 floor of section 4 (1) on RL-val
Q6.text: O1 cites 'the section 4 bar', defined on full navtest with two pairs. applies = B - A PDMS point >= +0.25 at u1000; not_applicable = RL-val needs only LB > 0.

Q7.what: scope of 'no longitudinal / lateral component separates adversely'
Q7.text: adverse = the B - A interval lies entirely below 0 at u1000. narrow = EP, DAC; longlat = EP, TTC, DAC, DDC; all = all six sub-scores.

Q8.text: O5 lists K0-K2 and K4-K6; K-MON is the chain's fail-closed stop of a dead monitor and is not listed. O5 = count it as 'other kill'; not_O5 = it is no outcome.
